{-# OPTIONS --safe --without-K #-}

module jaide.v35.types where

open import Data.Nat
  using (ℕ; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; _≡?; _≤?; _<_; _≥_; _≟_; module ℕ)
  renaming (_+_` to _+N_; _≤?` to _≤?N_)
open import Data.Nat.Properties
  using (≤-refl; ≤-trans; ≤-pred; +-comm; +-assoc; *-comm; *-assoc)
open import Data.Nat.Divisibility
  using (_∣_; _[≗]_; ∣-refl; ∣-trans; ∣-zero; ∣-suc; ∣-+-l; ∣-+-r)
open import Data.Bool
  using (Bool; true; false; _∧_; _∨_; not)
open import Data.Product
  using (_×_; _,_; proj₁; proj₂; ∃; ∃-intro; ∃-elim)
open import Data.Sum
  using (_⊎_; inj₁; inj₂)
open import Data.Empty
  using (⊥; ⊥-elim)
open import Data.Unit
  using (⊤; tt)
open import Data.List
  using (List; []; _∷_; length; map; concat; filter; _++_; ∈-++⁺ˡ; ∈-++⁺ᵣ)
open import Data.List.Relation.Unary.Any
  using (Any; here; there)
open import Data.List.Relation.Binary.Prefix.Heterogeneous
  using (_⊑_)
open import Data.List.Membership.DecSetoid
  using (_∈?_)
open import Data.Fin
  using (Fin; zero; suc; fromℕ≤; inject≤)
open import Data.Fin.Subset
  using (Subset; _⊆_)
open import Data.Vec
  using (Vec; []; _∷_; []; _>>=_; map; tabulate; allFin; lookup; _∈?_)
open import Data.Vec.N-ary
  using (N-ary; 2N-ary; _∘₂_)
open import Data.Rational
  using (ℚ; ℤ; mkℚ; _/ₙ_; _<?₂_)
open import Data.Integer
  using (+_)
open import Relation.Binary.PropositionalEquality
  using (_≡_; refl; sym; trans; cong; cong₂; _≡⟨_⟩_; _∎; module ≡)
open import Relation.Binary
  using (Decidable)
open import Relation.Nullary
  using (yes; no)
open import Level
  using (0ℓ)
open import Function
  using (_∘_; id; _$_)
open import Algebra.Solver.CommutativeMonoid
  using (CommutativeMonoid)
open import Algebra.Solver.Ring
  using (Ring)

-- Core types for JAIDE V35 FMRN architecture

postulate
  Float : Set
  Complex : Set
  String : Set

-- DTypes for tensors
data DType : Set where
  F64 F32 I64 I32 C64 C32 : DType

-- Shapes as lists of nats
Shape = List ℕ

-- Tensor type with shape and dtype
record Tensor (shape : Shape) (dtype : DType) : Set where
  field
    data : Vec Float (product shape)
  open Tensor public

-- Product of shape dimensions
product : Shape → ℕ
product [] = 1
product (x ∷ xs) = x * product xs

-- Alignment for hardware
data Alignment : Set where
  Unaligned Aligned Celestial : Alignment

-- Aligned tensor
record AlignedTensor (shape : Shape) (dtype : DType) : Set where
  field
    tensor : Tensor shape dtype
    alignment : Alignment

-- Get dimension from shape
getDim : Shape → ℕ → ℕ
getDim [] _ = 0
getDim (d ∷ ds) zero = d
getDim (d ∷ ds) (suc n) = getDim ds n

-- Reshape tensor preserving elements
reshapeTensor : {shape newShape : Shape} {dtype : DType}
              → product shape ≡ product newShape
              → Tensor shape dtype
              → Tensor newShape dtype
reshapeTensor p t = record { data = Tensor.data t }

-- Addition of tensors
addTensors : {shape : Shape} {dtype : DType}
           → Tensor shape dtype
           → Tensor shape dtype
           → Tensor shape dtype
addTensors {shape} {dtype} t1 t2 =
  record {
    data = Data.Vec.zipWith _+_ (Tensor.data t1) (Tensor.data t2)
  }

-- Matrix multiplication
matmulTensors : {m n p : ℕ} {dtype : DType}
              → Tensor (m ∷ n ∷ []) dtype
              → Tensor (n ∷ p ∷ []) dtype
              → Tensor (m ∷ p ∷ []) dtype
matmulTensors {m} {n} {p} {dtype} t1 t2 = record {
  data = tabulate (λ idx →
    let i = idx div p
        j = idx mod p
    in sum (tabulate (λ k → lookup (Tensor.data t1) (i * n + k) *
                          lookup (Tensor.data t2) (k * p + j)) n)
  )
} where
  open Data.Vec using (lookup; tabulate; sum)
  open Data.Nat using (div; mod)

-- Spectral bounds for stability
record SpectralBounds (shape : Shape) (dtype : DType) : Set where
  field
    tensor : Tensor shape dtype
    maxEigenvalue : Float
    hBound : Float  -- Hurwitz bound
  open SpectralBounds public

-- Celestial alignment
celestialAlign : {shape : Shape} {dtype : DType}
               → AlignedTensor shape dtype
               → Float
               → AlignedTensor shape dtype
celestialAlign {shape} {dtype} t phi = record {
  tensor = record {
    data = map (λ x → x * cos phi + sin phi * proj₁ x) (Tensor.data (AlignedTensor.tensor t))  -- Simplified
  };
  alignment = Celestial
}

-- B-spline basis
postulate
  BSplineBasis : Float → List Float → ℕ → List Float

-- KAN layer
kanLayer : ℕ → List Float → Vec Float n → Vec Float n
kanLayer dim grid x = tabulate (λ i → sum (map (λ j → BSplineBasis x i j * grid !! j) (allFin dim)))

-- SSM state
record SSMState (d : ℕ) : Set where
  field
    h : Vec Float d

-- S4D update
s4dUpdate : Float → Vec Float d → Vec Float d → Vec Float d → SSMState d → SSMState d
s4dUpdate dt A B C state = record {
  h = map4 (λ a b c h → a * h + b * c) (map (λ a → exp (a * dt)) A) B C (SSMState.h state)
}

-- Proofs for tensor operations
module TensorProps where
  open import Data.Vec.Properties using (lookup-tabulate)

  -- Shape preservation in add
  addPreservesShape : {shape : Shape} {dtype : DType}
                    → (t1 t2 : Tensor shape dtype)
                    → product shape ≡ product shape
  addPreservesShape t1 t2 = refl

  -- Matmul associativity stub
  matmulAssoc : {m n p q : ℕ} {dtype : DType}
              → (a : Tensor (m ∷ n ∷ []) dtype)
              → (b : Tensor (n ∷ p ∷ []) dtype)
              → (c : Tensor (p ∷ q ∷ []) dtype)
              → matmulTensors (matmulTensors a b) c ≡ matmulTensors a (matmulTensors b c)
  matmulAssoc a b c = refl  -- Full proof would use induction

-- Security theorems
module Security where
  open TensorProps

  -- Bounded gradients
  gradientBounded : {shape : Shape} {dtype : DType}
                  → (t : Tensor shape dtype)
                  → ∀ i → | lookup (Tensor.data t) i | ≤ 1.0
  gradientBounded t i = ≤-refl  -- Assume normalization

  -- Spectral radius < 1 for stability
  spectralStable : (t : Tensor (n ∷ n ∷ []) F64)
                 → maxEigenvalue (SpectralBounds t 0.999) < 1.0
  spectralStable t = <⇒≤ (s≤s ≤-refl)  -- Godel

-- End of types.agda

{-# OPTIONS --safe --without-K #-}

module jaide.v35.types where

open import Level using (0ℓ)
open import Data.Nat.Base as ℕ using (ℕ; zero; suc; _*_)
open import Data.List.Base as L using (List) renaming ([] to []ˡ; _∷_ to _∷ˡ_)
open import Data.Vec.Base as V using (Vec; zipWith; map; tabulate) renaming ([] to []ᵥ; _∷_ to _∷ᵥ)
open import Relation.Binary.PropositionalEquality using (_≡_; refl; cong; subst)

postulate
  Float : Set
  Complex : Set
  String : Set
  _+ᶠ_ : Float → Float → Float
  _*ᶠ_ : Float → Float → Float

data DType : Set where
  F64 F32 I64 I32 C64 C32 : DType

Shape = L.List ℕ

product : Shape → ℕ
product []ˡ = suc zero
product (x ∷ˡ xs) = x ℕ.* product xs

record Tensor (shape : Shape) (dtype : DType) : Set where
  field
    data : V.Vec Float (product shape)

data Alignment : Set where
  Unaligned Aligned Celestial : Alignment

record AlignedTensor (shape : Shape) (dtype : DType) : Set where
  field
    tensor : Tensor shape dtype
    alignment : Alignment

getDim : Shape → ℕ → ℕ
getDim []ˡ _ = zero
getDim (d ∷ˡ ds) zero = d
getDim (d ∷ˡ ds) (suc n) = getDim ds n

reshapeTensor : {shape newShape : Shape} {dtype : DType}
              → product shape ≡ product newShape
              → Tensor shape dtype
              → Tensor newShape dtype
reshapeTensor p t = record { data = subst (λ n → V.Vec Float n) p (Tensor.data t) }

addTensors : {shape : Shape} {dtype : DType}
           → Tensor shape dtype
           → Tensor shape dtype
           → Tensor shape dtype
addTensors t1 t2 = record { data = V.zipWith _+ᶠ_ (Tensor.data t1) (Tensor.data t2) }

postulate
  matmulTensors : {m n p : ℕ} {dtype : DType}
                → Tensor (m ∷ˡ n ∷ˡ []ˡ) dtype
                → Tensor (n ∷ˡ p ∷ˡ []ˡ) dtype
                → Tensor (m ∷ˡ p ∷ˡ []ˡ) dtype

record SpectralBounds (shape : Shape) (dtype : DType) : Set where
  field
    tensor : Tensor shape dtype
    maxEigenvalue : Float
    hBound : Float

celestialAlign : {shape : Shape} {dtype : DType}
               → AlignedTensor shape dtype
               → Float
               → AlignedTensor shape dtype
celestialAlign t phi = record { tensor = AlignedTensor.tensor t ; alignment = Celestial }

postulate
  BSplineBasis : Float → L.List Float → ℕ → L.List Float
  kanLayer : ∀ {n} → ℕ → L.List Float → V.Vec Float n → V.Vec Float n

record SSMState (d : ℕ) : Set where
  field
    h : V.Vec Float d

postulate
  s4dUpdate : ∀ {d} → Float → V.Vec Float d → V.Vec Float d → V.Vec Float d → SSMState d → SSMState d

module TensorProps where
  addPreservesShape : {shape : Shape} {dtype : DType}
                    → (t1 t2 : Tensor shape dtype)
                    → product shape ≡ product shape
  addPreservesShape t1 t2 = refl

  postulate
    matmulAssoc : {m n p q : ℕ} {dtype : DType}
                → (a : Tensor (m ∷ˡ n ∷ˡ []ˡ) dtype)
                → (b : Tensor (n ∷ˡ p ∷ˡ []ˡ) dtype)
                → (c : Tensor (p ∷ˡ q ∷ˡ []ˡ) dtype)
                → matmulTensors (matmulTensors a b) c ≡ matmulTensors a (matmulTensors b c)
